SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ts_hour,
  ts_t,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_temp_c,
  COUNT(*) as samples
FROM pier
WHERE ts_t >= (SELECT MAX(ts_t) FROM pier) - 14
GROUP BY ts_t, ts_doy, ts_hour
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  fish_date_t,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(landing, boat)) as num_boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 4) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_t >= 594.5
GROUP BY fish_date_t, fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_t DESC, cls
LIMIT 50

import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']
climate = tables['climate']

# Boat performance in last week (d237-d244)
recent_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_t'] >= 601].copy()
boat_perf = recent_trips.groupby(['landing', 'boat']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'fish_date_doy': 'count'
}).rename(columns={'fish_date_doy': 'trips'})
boat_perf['yt_per_angler'] = boat_perf['yt'] / boat_perf['anglers']
boat_perf = boat_perf.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)

print("Boat Performance (d237-d244)")
print(boat_perf.head(20).to_string())

print("\n\nCurrent ONI (El Niño Index)")
oni = climate[climate['index_id'] == 'oni'].sort_values('avail_t', ascending=False).head(5)
print(oni[['value', 'avail_doy']].to_string())
